scope: Developer-only original teaching-schematic search/get and detached geometry checks, linked to separate fixed public native catalog evidence. No new MCP tool, external layout importer, construction/execution or player release.

legend.E: Hypothetical entry; no actual door or exterior map checked

authored_geometry.check_scope: Detached rectangle/overlap/orthogonal connectivity and adjacent access only; not game construction or pathfinding.

nominal_compatibility_scope: Exact catalog version only; other numeric versions unknown, and matching version text does not attest player mods/catalog.
selected_checks: Search summaries omit geometry; fetch requests one original example with source/author/rights/evidence and caveats.
Checksum mismatch, duplicate identity/JSON keys, nonfinite constants, coerced Boolean dimensions/schema/catalog numbers, unknown execution/origin fields and unsupported catalog facts refuse.
Bounds, overlap, boundary entry, disconnected authored orthogonal aisles and missing adjacent access refuse; result dictionaries/lists own their copies.
Native report pins one public 2x1 warehouse catalog item; no room/item placed, game pathfinder or resource/throughput formula invoked.
limits: The 5x5 teaching grid is original authored data. Elementary grid connectivity plus catalog flags does not prove construction legality, usable real door/roof/materials, storage capacity, staffing, throughput, optimum or a tested live-world blueprint.
No third-party blueprint, screenshot/video/source assets, code or user-save layout is copied. Existing external candidates remain unreviewed geometry/rights leads.
Checksums bind reviewed repository artifacts, not signatures or authentication that an arbitrary supplied report was produced by the game.

Only developer Python search/get is implemented; no production MCP schema/client/tool/library integration or paid/new player acceptance is claimed. The fifteen-record production guidance corpus and tested latest/previous bundles remain unchanged.
